summary: Two timestamped posts by former members that date the changes to the Divine Light Mission light technique from the practitioner's side. One, initiated in 1972, says that at a Knowledge review around 1985 the light technique was revised, techniques were renamed, and premies were told to practise once a day for fifteen minutes on each technique, after she had spent more than a decade on a different regime. The other, initiated in 1976, was taught to press on the eyeballs and says a review between 1976 and 1981 eased the pressure; returning in the late 1990s she found she had been doing the techniques in a different order from the one then taught. Neither describes what she saw. Useful mainly as corroboration for the instruction record and for the Strasburg testimony.
why_relevant: Platform-dated corroboration that the eye-pressure form of the light technique was taught in the 1970s and later withdrawn; no report of seen light.

date_evidence.basis: Forum software timestamps on the posts (Wed, May 15, 2002 at 07:33:06 and 08:44:08 PDT); the archive page spans about May 3 to May 15, 2002.

notes: Reader extract covering the whole archive page in two calls. Thin: no seen-light content; may be dropped by the reading agent as corroboration only.
